VITAL:
I Lit.: by comp.,
v. air:
प्राणवायुः
: v. Life, spirit. Ph.:
v. part:
मर्मन् (n.).
II Essential, necessary: q. v.

VITALLY:
I Lit.: expr. by circumlo.
II
Essentially, particularly: q. v.

VITALS:
I Lit.: मर्माणि (n. pl.).
II Fig.:
आलम्बः: v. Support.

VITIATE: दूषयति (c. of दुष्): v. To corrupt,
pollute, destroy.

VITIATION: दूषणम्: v. Corruption, pollution,
destruction.

VITREOUS:
(1) काचज (f. जा etc. = produced
from glass);
(2) काचमय (f. यी = consisting of
glass.);
(3) काचाम (f. भा etc. = resembling
glass).

VITRIOL:
I Blue:
(1) तुत्थम्, -कम्;
(2) वितुन्न-
कम् (rare).
II Green:
(1) कासी(शी)सम्;
(2)
पुष्पकम् (rare).

VITUPERATE: आक्षिपति (क्षिप्, c. 6.): v. To
censure, revile.
